title: WATCH: Elon Musk appears to give fascist salute during Trump inauguration celebration
summary: A short PBS NewsHour clip of Elon Musk making a gesture at the post-inauguration celebration in January 2025, which many described as a fascist salute. The report includes the remarks he made just before it.
why: HN mostly uses it as a primary-source link in long political arguments about the gesture, not as something to recommend.
